# Sample exports for the import tests (SAMPLE — FICTIONAL COMPANY)

Hollybank Joinery Ltd is fictional; every name, number and figure here is made up. The files imitate the layouts
the vendors' help pages describe (sources in `services/runtime/app/import_formats.py`) but were written by hand,
not exported from the products: the exact header spellings are unconfirmed (docs/HONESTY.md).
